title: Quick Roasted Norwegian Beef Braise
description: A hearty, umami-packed beef braise featuring the rich flavors of wholegrain mustard and Norwegian beef. Quick to make and low in carbs, perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the beef on all sides until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove the beef from the pot and set it aside.
Add the carrots and celery to the pot and cook until they begin to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the wholegrain mustard and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth, red wine (if using), bay leaves, thyme, and black peppercorns to the pot.
Return the beef to the pot, bring the liquid to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the beef for 2 hours, or until tender and easily shredded with a fork.
Remove the pot from the oven and season the beef with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the beef with the vegetables and sauce spooned over the top.
Strain the sauce through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean saucepan and simmer over low heat until reduced and thickened, about 10 minutes.
